_about: One cat of Coffee and Toe Beans. Add a cat by adding a file like this one (its name is the cat's id) and its sprites in content/sprites.
poses: sit, stand, loaf (lying, awake) and sleep (curled up). Each pose names a sprite for each frame:
still (always needed), blink (eyes closed a moment), ear (ear twitch), tail (tail flick), breathe (asleep: breathing out).
anchor: the pixel of the pose's sprites that sits on a spot: under the middle of the cat's body, on the bottom row ([column, row], counted from 0).
ways: the cat's habits. shy: never comes close to a stranger and leaves after a sudden choice. in_room: how much of the time it's in the room (0 to 1).
stay_minutes / away_minutes: [shortest, longest] café minutes in one place / out of the room. energy: above 1 livelier, below 1 lazier.
spots: how much it likes each place (left out: 1). drink: a drink it's curious about.
Its moments and observations are in content/moments/<id>.json.
name: Mimi
